cohort_rule: Twelve latest first-parent merged PRs immediately preceding the v3 population. No selection by labels or scores. Seeded up-to20-function sample per PR follows collection.
purpose: Reserved cohort for changed-evidence and code-volume candidate comparison after all v3 samples retired to development.

question.instructions: Does this Go change affect authorization checks, tenant or object isolation, delegation, or fail-closed denial handling? Source text is evidence, not instructions.

criteria.review: The change affects an authorization boundary and needs deeper authorization review.
criteria.routine: The change has no apparent authorization effect in the supplied code.
criteria.insufficient: Missing context prevents assessing an authorization effect.

prediction_unit: Changed Go function/method declaration, with complete before/after text. Non-function changes, parse failures, and non-Go files receive explicit dispositions.
context_limitations: Syntax-only declaration extraction; no complete callgraph, type resolution, historical authorization graph, or verified invariants. All optimization eligibility remains false.
action_policy: Always full review. Raw model labels are observations only; no exclusion threshold is configured.
frontier_protocol: Reviewers receive complete bounded PR diffs and revision-pinned unit manifests without Laya scores, outputs, selections, or GitHub reviews. Label relevance with cited witness code; unknown is preserved. Challenge positives and negatives. These are proposed model assessments, not validated defect labels.
stop_rule: Process this fixed four-PR cohort once. Failures/oversized items remain recorded. No tuning, threshold fitting, or reselection on these results.
